title: flatRoutes
summary: Discover a flat route table at build time.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: directory is the path to the routes folder.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A Promise<RouteFile[] | Error>. Each item contains a route pattern and module filepath.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Node filesystem access is required; do not import this entry into browser components. Only immediate flat files and route folders are discovered. Invalid patterns and conflicting parameter shapes return Error values. The Vite plugin normally calls this for you.
